# UDPMsgIP <img class="product" src="media/bb-20x14.png" alt="BlitzBasic" title="BlitzBasic" width="20" height="14">

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [BlitzBasic](BlitzBasic) · [Network](BlitzBasic-Network)

</div>


```blitzbasic
UDPMsgIP:Int32 udp_stream:Int32
```

| Parameter | Mode | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `udp_stream` | In | Int32 | required | The stream. |

**Returns:** The address of the sender of the last message that [RecvUDPMsg](RecvUDPMsg) received.

## Description

_Not documented yet._

## Differences

* A sender that uses IPv6 has no address as a number, so this returns 0 for it; use [GetUDPMsgAddress](GetUDPMsgAddress). IPv4 senders are not changed.
